task.title: October vendor payments
task.objective: Pay every approved October vendor invoice in invoice order, except INV-104 (Northwind Traders), which stays on hold until the user releases it.
task.outcome: Each approved invoice other than INV-104 is paid exactly once, in invoice order, and each payment is confirmed in the bank payment list.

success_criteria.description: INV-103 (Initech Services, $8,900.00) is paid exactly once. Its status is unknown.
INV-104 (Northwind Traders) is not paid until the user releases it.

includes: Approved October vendor invoices INV-101 through INV-105 on the AP list.
excludes: INV-104 (Northwind Traders) until the user releases it.

completed.description: Listed approved invoices and bank payments. The payment list was empty at the start.
Paid INV-101 (Acme Supply, $12,400.00). Payment PMT-5001 was accepted.
Paid INV-102 (Globex Freight, $3,150.00). Payment PMT-5002 was accepted.
Sent pay_invoice for INV-103 (Initech Services, $8,900.00). The bank timed out after 30 seconds, and the payment status is unknown.

focus.description: Determining whether the INV-103 payment reached the bank before any further payment is sent. The payment-list check failed when the session ended.

next.description: Confirm whether INV-103 was paid, by checking the bank payment list for a payment to Initech Services for $8,900.00. If the list cannot be reached, ask the user to check the bank portal.
If INV-103 is confirmed unpaid, pay $8,900.00 to Initech Services with pay_invoice. If it is confirmed paid, record it as completed and skip the payment.
After INV-103 is settled, confirm INV-105 still shows approved, then pay $2,275.00 to Umbrella Logistics.
Keep INV-104 (Northwind Traders) on hold until the user releases it.

statements.text: Pay only invoices whose AP status is approved.
pay_invoice sends money, and the bank does not reverse payments. A repeated send can pay a vendor twice.
Run the October vendor payments: pay every approved invoice, in invoice order.
Hold Northwind Traders (INV-104) until the user releases it. The vendor is disputing a short delivery.

The AP list showed INV-101 through INV-105 with ap_status approved: Acme Supply $12,400.00, Globex Freight $3,150.00, Initech Services $8,900.00, Northwind Traders $5,600.00, and Umbrella Logistics $2,275.00.

verification.method: list_invoices output from earlier in the session

statements.text: pay_invoice for INV-101 was accepted as PMT-5001.
pay_invoice for INV-102 was accepted as PMT-5002.
pay_invoice for INV-103 returned a bank gateway timeout after 30 seconds. The payment status is unknown.
The list_payments check for INV-103 failed because the session ended and the connection to the backend was lost. No action was taken, and the INV-103 payment status has not been checked.
Do not resend INV-103 until its payment status is confirmed.
statements.rationale: The bank cannot reverse a payment, so a second send could pay Initech Services twice.

statements.text: Hold INV-105 until INV-103 is settled.
statements.rationale: The user asked for payments in invoice order, and INV-103 is unresolved.

statements.text: Did the bank process a payment of $8,900.00 to Initech Services for INV-103?

operations.description: Pay INV-103 (Initech Services, $8,900.00) with pay_invoice. The bank timed out after 30 seconds, and the outcome is unknown.
Pay INV-104 (Northwind Traders, $5,600.00) with pay_invoice. Held until the user releases it.
Pay INV-105 (Umbrella Logistics, $2,275.00) with pay_invoice, after INV-103 is settled.

requirements.name: list_invoices
requirements.description: Lists invoices with their AP status.
requirements.fallback: Ask the user to confirm the current AP status of INV-105 before paying it.

requirements.name: list_payments
requirements.description: Lists payments the bank has recorded.
requirements.fallback: Ask the user to check the bank portal for a payment to Initech Services for INV-103. Do not pay INV-103 until that answer is given.

requirements.name: pay_invoice
requirements.description: Sends a payment for an invoice. Payments cannot be reversed.
requirements.fallback: None. Stop and report to the user.

preconditions.description: The INV-103 payment status is confirmed as paid or unpaid in the bank payment list.
list_invoices is re-run, and each invoice to be paid still shows ap_status approved.

stop_conditions.description: Do not call pay_invoice for INV-103 until its payment status is verified.
Do not pay INV-104 unless the user releases it.
Do not pay any invoice whose AP status is not approved.

recovery.description: Call list_payments and look for a payment to Initech Services for $8,900.00 for INV-103.
Tell the user the INV-103 result before paying any further invoice.
